method: Native Safari and Chrome through CUA, native toolbar/keyboard actions, reload, download and OS file chooser. No injected DOM events or direct storage writes. Observations retained in task tool history; backup identity independently read from the downloaded file.

chrome.initialState: Fresh sample on this test origin: Heading 2, two bullet items, numbered items starting at 3, no undo/redo.
actions: Select the heading using click, Command-Left and Command-Shift-Right. Apply Heading 3, Bullet list, Numbered list and Remove list. Observe unchanged selected text and heading rank through each transition.
Undo and redo Remove list; observe numbered heading and unwrapped Heading 3 respectively.
Apply Link https://example.com/breditor-latest to the selected heading. Close Link panel and use toolbar Undo; text remains selected, link is absent, Redo enabled.
After All changes saved, reload. Heading 3, selected text and Redo survive. Redo restores the Link. Reopen Link panel and verify exact URL.
Undo the Link again, download a session backup. Browser reports Done; filesystem confirms the new 8153-byte JSON.
Import that exact downloaded file using the native file chooser. Recovered editor opens with autosave off, Heading 3 and pending Redo; main editor remains unchanged.

Redo in recovered editor and verify exact Link URL. Close recovery and reload the page: main editor still has Heading 3 without a link and with its pending Redo. Recovered changes did not overwrite main autosave.
inputCaveats: Command-Z while focus was on the Link toolbar button did not mutate history; toolbar Undo was used explicitly. This is not reported as an editor-focused shortcut failure.

Native Go-to-file input produced transient stale/incorrect path observations and one paste timeout. Import was performed only after the normal chooser showed the exact current filename and matching preview. No historical backup was imported.

backup.content: Only the disposable demonstration text and test Link; retained locally, not uploaded to an external service.

crossBrowserRecovery: Open the fresh main sample on the same test origin in Safari: Heading 2 and no undo/redo.

Import the Chrome-downloaded file through the native picker after verifying its exact filename and preview. Recovered editor shows Heading 3, original list text/numbering, selection and pending Redo. Main remains Heading 2. Recovery autosave is off.
Redo restores Link; reopen the panel and verify https://example.com/breditor-latest.
Undo all five imported actions individually. Observe Link removal, numbered Heading 3, bullet Heading 3, unwrapped Heading 3, original Heading 2 with Undo disabled. Selected heading text persists.
Redo all five individually. Observe Heading 3, bullet, numbered, unwrapped Heading 3, exact Link with Redo disabled. Other list content and numbering remain unchanged.
Close recovered session, acknowledge discarding only these disposable recovery edits. Main remains untouched Heading 2.
nativeAutosave: Click Write a first draft, Command-Right, type !; numbered item 3 changes once, item 4 is unchanged. Undo restores the original text and enables Redo.
Reload the saved main editor. Original text and pending Redo survive; Redo restores Write a first draft! with correct surrounding text and numbering.
Undo restores the sample text again. All changes saved; no recovered-session content leaked into main autosave.

sideEffects.testOriginStorage: Only the test origin 127.0.0.1:4298 now has these synthetic saved histories in the two native browsers. Existing demo origins were not modified.

limits: Native visible selection and replay checked; exact UTF-16 backup endpoints independently inspected. This is not exhaustive coverage of every direction, format combination or document size.
No physical Japanese IME or spoken VoiceOver qualification. Prior permissions remain, but actual input/speech participation is still required.
The independent intermittent queueUncertain fault did not reproduce and is not declared fixed.
Delivery choice, reviewed package budgets, responsiveness boundaries and final release qualification remain open. Nothing pushed or published.
